skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — generate and download subtitles for my video in English — and get subtitle...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Subtitle Download — generate and download video subtitles via cloud AI.

- Seamlessly generate accurate English subtitles for uploaded videos (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB).
- Automatic setup: handles token creation, session management, and cloud connection.
- Simple workflow: upload, describe your request, and download finished video in seconds.
- Supports subtitle export in multiple formats (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, MKV).
- Transparent status, credits, and error handling with friendly messages throughout.
- Designed for speed and ease of use—no manual transcription or editing software required.
